15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
DOW (-45): dividend cut concern, but price action diverges sharply from the negative sentiment; DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.00% | 1M: +21.31%). NFLX (-40) and T (-40) both show sentiment confirmation, with NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.52% | 1M: -10.19%) and T BELOW TREND (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -16.92%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Major divergences, including MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.18%), warrant caution; positive MSFT sentiment is not yet confirmed by weekly price action.
